what: One image with alpha (a cut-out flower and the like) is drawn as a milky, frosted panel with .68 × .8 translucency, .58 desaturation and .92 exposure, and sparkles with per-pixel grain that changes 8 times a second (strength .86). When the pointer touches the image, only the area within radius .16 × 1.7 (ratio of screen height) is lit like a lens in the clear original color. The lens trails the pointer in three layers (.14 → .065 → .04, tail .03), turning on at .13 and off at .025 per step. With no pointer, it picks a random spot inside the painted area every 2.6~5.2s, drifts by .008 and lights it at .78 strength. On open, the grain gathers and the image settles after .2s over 6s. Sending fx:dissolve(0~1) scatters it back into grain and spreads upward.

options.scale · x · y: Image size (multiple of contain fitted to the element) · push from center (ratio of element size), default 1 · 0 · 0. On phone (≤768) use scale-sm · x-sm · y-sm
options.sat · exposure: Saturation · exposure outside the lens, default .58 · .92
options.intro · delay · intro-ease: Settle-in duration, delay, curve, default 6 · .2 · sine.out
options.start: If wait, the settling is delayed until fx:start is sent to the element (after the loader), default is immediate
options.[data-fx-part=image]: Required image — Or pre-drawn . When the canvas is redrawn, the element gets fx:repaint
options.fx:dissolve: Event sent to the element — detail 0~1 (scroll progress, etc.). At 1 everything is fully scattered

note: The original shader’s curvature, color phase and feather texture layers were not carried over. Only the same impression (frosted, grainy, lens) was rebuilt. Outside-lens strength .78, drift interval and follow ratio are the original values.
